title: Keyboard Manager remap shortcut (sent text) only runs once
author: shimself

status.label: Needs repeated-trigger confirmation
status.detail: The v0.97.1 report has a clear one-time text-send symptom, but there is no current-build retest. Related reports were routed to this still-open canonical issue.

next_action: Ask whether Ctrl+' still sends the configured text only once on a current build and capture the exact press/release sequence and target app.

judgment.rationale: The reporter says a Ctrl+' shortcut that sends an email address works once and then does nothing until a reboot. The report is from PowerToys 0.97.1 and has no comments. Maintainers closed #41153 and #31839 as duplicates of this issue, so #45278 remains the canonical open report; those duplicate links do not establish that the behavior is fixed. Current main sends shortcut text through Helpers::SendTextInput and consumes the matching event, but that path alone does not establish why a later trigger may fail.
evidence: Issue #45278 is open, unassigned, labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, and Product-Keyboard Manager, and has no comments; its 2026-10-11 update changed labels only.
The reporter lists PowerToys 0.97.1 and says the Ctrl+' (shown as Ctrl@) shortcut sends "me@mydomain.com" once, then does nothing until reboot.
Maintainers closed #41153 and #31839 as duplicates of #45278; #45278 itself remains open.

At upstream main 0b1dd814878f0dfbb07787d9c3e52a2897b6f769, KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp:1099-1103 calls Helpers::SendTextInput for shortcut-to-text remaps and consumes the event; this does not establish whether transient shortcut state is reset correctly after repeated sends.
No linked pull request or current-version reproduction was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a current-build retest with the exact key-down/key-up sequence and target application before proposing a state-reset change.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repeat-trigger state or synthetic-input cleanup problem is plausible, but the report does not establish whether the shortcut still fails on current builds or whether the trigger modifiers are fully released between attempts.

issue_context.summary: A Ctrl+' shortcut configured to send an email address works once, then stops sending text until reboot.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.97.1 and says the shortcut is triggered by Ctrl+' (displayed as Ctrl@).
The configured text is "me@mydomain.com"; the first trigger succeeds and later triggers do not until reboot.
Maintainers closed #41153 and #31839 as duplicates of this issue, which remains open.
The issue has no comments or assignee; the latest upstream activity was a label-only update on 2026-10-11.
inferences: A stale shortcut-invocation state or incomplete cleanup around synthetic text input could prevent the second trigger, but the report does not show whether all physical keys were released.
The target application could affect how injected text is accepted, so a plain text editor provides a useful control.
issue_context.analysis: The original report already gives the trigger and expected text, and the related issues are deliberately routed here. Current main's shortcut-to-text branch calls Helpers::SendTextInput and returns after handling the event; the relevant key/modifier release and repeat behavior still needs a current reproduction. Ask only for a current-version result, the precise release sequence, and whether the same failure occurs in a plain text editor; do not request a diagnostic archive that the report does not need yet.
initial_investigation: Read the live issue body, labels, assignees, comments, and timeline through 2026-10-11T16:48:51Z; there are no comments, assignees, or direct linked pull requests.
Read the maintainer duplicate closures on #41153 and #31839 pointing to #45278.

Read current upstream source at 0b1dd814878f0dfbb07787d9c3e52a2897b6f769: src/modules/keyboardmanager/KeyboardManagerEngineLibrary/KeyboardEventHandlers.cpp:1099-1103 and src/modules/keyboardmanager/common/Helpers.cpp:317-329.

information_gaps.information: Whether the send-text shortcut still succeeds only once on a current PowerToys build, and whether the same failure occurs in a plain text editor.
information_gaps.why_needed: The only reproduction is from v0.97.1, and a control application helps separate Keyboard Manager input handling from application-specific behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Retest the shortcut in a plain text editor on the latest installed stable build and include the exact PowerToys version and whether the second trigger inserts any text.

information_gaps.information: The exact key-down/key-up sequence between the first and second Ctrl+' trigger, including whether Ctrl and the apostrophe key are fully released.
information_gaps.why_needed: A stale invocation state is only a hypothesis; key-release timing determines whether the repeat path can be reached.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Describe whether both keys are released before the second trigger and whether switching focus or waiting changes the result; no diagnostic upload is needed for this step.

proposed_fixes.title: Reset shortcut-to-text state after a completed send
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: the shortcut's invocation or synthetic-input state remains active after the first Helpers::SendTextInput call, preventing a later trigger from being matched. The current report does not establish whether this state is actually stale.
plan: Confirm the issue on a current build with Ctrl+' mapped to the reported text, fully release both keys between attempts, and compare a plain text editor with the original target app.
Trace shortcut invocation, modifier release and text-injection cleanup through HandleShortcutRemapEvent and Helpers::SendTextInput.
If a state-reset gap is confirmed, reset only the completed text-remap invocation state and add a regression test that triggers the same shortcut twice without restarting PowerToys.
verification: The configured text is inserted on each of two successive Ctrl+' triggers without restarting PowerToys.
The trigger keys are released normally and no extra Ctrl or apostrophe input reaches the target application.
Existing shortcut-to-key, shortcut-to-shortcut, and text-remap behavior remains unchanged.

confidence.rationale: The one-time symptom is clear, but it is reported only on v0.97.1 and no current reproduction or key-release sequence is available.

actions.label: Approve repeated text-remap investigation
actions.note: Proceed to a code design only if a current-build test confirms that the same shortcut still fails on its second trigger.

comment.body:
Thanks for providing the Ctrl+' trigger, the text to send, and the result that the first attempt works. Could you confirm:
- Whether this still happens on a current PowerToys build, including its version, and whether the second attempt inserts any text.
- Whether Ctrl and the apostrophe key are fully released before the second attempt.
- Whether the same test fails in a plain text editor or only in the original target app.

This check does not require an upload.
